spec_family.name: Interior Bare Drywall — New Construction Prime
spec_family.description: Priming of bare (unpainted) drywall in new construction settings. Covers walls and ceilings with standard PVA or high-build primer. Supports both pre-trim (before baseboard/casing installed) and post-trim (after fixtures and trim installed) project phases. Includes brush/roll and spray application methods with mandatory backroll for spray. Does NOT cover: topcoat application, stain-blocking situations, Level 5 skim coat preparation, or exterior applications.

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier applied to this spec. QT4/QT5 add inspection, touch-up, and sanding rounds.
Type of drywall surface being primed
Primary application method for primer. Spray requires mandatory wet-on-wet backroll.
Installation phase determines edge work complexity. Pre-trim has fewer obstructions; post-trim requires cutting around installed trim and fixtures.

paintable_items.name: Bare Drywall Wall Area
paintable_items.counting_rules: Total square footage of bare drywall wall surfaces to be primed. Measured by PaintScope. Deduct openings (windows, doors) per standard takeoff rules.
paintable_items.notes: Field area for roller or spray application.

paintable_items.name: Bare Drywall Ceiling Area
paintable_items.counting_rules: Total square footage of bare drywall ceiling surfaces to be primed. Measured by PaintScope.
paintable_items.notes: Overhead work. Production rates slower than wall due to ergonomics.

paintable_items.name: Wall Edge Linear Feet (Cut-In)
paintable_items.counting_rules: Total linear feet of edges requiring brush cut-in on walls. Pre-trim: ceiling lines + inside corners. Post-trim: adds baseboard perimeter, door/window casing, outlets, switches. PaintScope provides based on project_phase.
paintable_items.notes: EdgeLF varies significantly between pre_trim and post_trim phases.

paintable_items.name: Ceiling Edge Linear Feet (Cut-In)
paintable_items.counting_rules: Total linear feet of edges requiring brush cut-in on ceilings. Pre-trim: perimeter only. Post-trim: adds fixture perimeters, HVAC registers. PaintScope provides based on project_phase.
paintable_items.notes: Overhead cut-in is slower than wall cut-in.

variants.notes: Wall priming via brush/roll before trim installed. Minimal cut-in obstruction.
Wall priming via brush/roll after trim installed. More detailed cut-in required.
Wall priming via spray with mandatory wet-on-wet backroll. Pre-trim phase.
Wall priming via spray with mandatory wet-on-wet backroll. Post-trim phase with detailed cut-in.
Ceiling priming via brush/roll before fixtures installed. Perimeter cut-in only.
Ceiling priming via brush/roll after fixtures installed. Cut-in around fixtures required.
Ceiling priming via spray with mandatory wet-on-wet backroll. Pre-trim phase.
Ceiling priming via spray with mandatory wet-on-wet backroll. Post-trim with fixture cut-in.

assumptions: Drywall is at Level 4 finish standard (joints taped, mudded, sanded by drywall contractor)
Drywall is dry and properly cured (no moisture issues)
This spec covers PRIMER ONLY — topcoat application is a separate spec family
Standard residential/commercial ceiling heights (8-10 ft) unless height modifiers applied
Spray application on bare drywall REQUIRES immediate wet-on-wet backroll — dry rolling is NOT permitted
Pre-trim phase: Priming occurs BEFORE baseboard, door/window casing, ceiling fixtures installed
Post-trim phase: Priming occurs AFTER all fixtures, cabinets, trim, and flooring installed
EdgeLF for cut-in is provided by PaintScope based on project_phase and room geometry
PVA primer is standard; high-build primer available as option for QT5 or imperfect surfaces
Single primer coat is baseline; QT5 may require second coat or high-build primer
exclusions: Topcoat (finish coat) application — see separate SF_DRYWALL_INT_FINISH spec family
Stain-blocking primer applications — see SF_DRYWALL_INT_STAINBLOCK spec family
Level 5 skim coat preparation (drywall contractor scope)
Joint compound repairs or drywall installation (drywall contractor scope)
Floor protection and masking (separate protection module)
Exterior drywall or cement board applications
Dry backrolling of sprayed primer — NOT permitted on bare drywall
